title: Washingwood site-data contract
description: The interface between the pipeline and the site. Each document kind is an entry point under $defs: league, trophyShelf, ownerIndex, owner, season.

league.title: League summary
league.description: Site-wide facts shown on Home and in navigation. Exported as league.json.

seasons.description: Every Season with a Season document, oldest first.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in the Season.

champion.description: The Champion of the most recent Season.

teamName.description: The Champion Franchise's team name that Season.

year.description: The Season the title was won.

trophyShelf.title: Trophy shelf
trophyShelf.description: Every Owner's career honours, shown on Home. Exported as trophy-shelf.json.

owners.description: One entry per Owner, former Owners included. Ordered by title count, then runner-up count (both descending), then name.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

ownerIndex.title: Owner index
ownerIndex.description: Every Owner, for the Owners index page. Exported as owners.json.

owners.description: One entry per Owner, former Owners included. Ordered like the trophy shelf: title count, then runner-up count (both descending), then name.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

regularSeason.description: Career regular-season record: the sum of the Owner's records in each Season's standings. Playoff and consolation Matchups are not included.

owner.title: Owner document
owner.description: Everything one Owner's page shows. Exported as owners/<slug>.json.
The Owner. The file name is its slug.

currentTeamName.description: Current team name: the team name of the Owner's most recent Franchise.

firstSeason.description: The Owner's first Season in the League.

lastSeason.description: The Owner's most recent Season in the League.

isFormer.description: True if the Owner has no Franchise in the most recent Season.

titles.description: Seasons the Owner was Champion, oldest first.

runnerUps.description: Seasons the Owner lost the championship Matchup, oldest first.

thirds.description: Seasons the Owner won the Third-place game, oldest first.

regularSeason.description: Career regular-season record: the sum of the Owner's records in each Season's standings.

playoffs.description: Career Playoff record: championship-bracket Matchups played. Byes, the Third-place game and consolation Matchups are excluded; a two-week round counts once.

avgPointsFor.description: Regular-season points for per game across the career (standings points for / regular-season games), rounded to 2 decimals.

avgPointsAgainst.description: Regular-season points against per game across the career, rounded to 2 decimals.

playoffAppearances.description: Seasons with a Playoff appearance (seed within the playoff field; a bye counts), oldest first.

lastPlaces.description: Seasons the Owner finished Last place (highest playoff seed), oldest first.

seasons.description: One row per Season the Owner played, newest first.

teamName.description: The Owner's team name that Season.

record.description: Regular-season record, as in that Season's standings.

pointsFor.description: Points for, as in that Season's standings.

pointsAgainst.description: Points against, as in that Season's standings.

finalRank.description: Final place that Season, as in that Season's standings.

podiumPlace.description: 1, 2 or 3 for a Podium finish, otherwise null.

isLastPlace.description: True if the Owner was that Season's Last place.

draft.description: The Owner's Picks, one entry per Season they played, newest first.

teamName.description: The Owner's team name that Season.

slot.description: The Owner's Draft slot that Season (their round-1 pick number).

grade.description: The Owner's Draft grade that Season: rank within the Season (ties share the better rank), out of how many Franchises, and the total Points over expected.

rank.description: Rank within the Season, 1 = best Draft.

total.description: The sum of the Owner's Points over expected that Season.

picks.description: The Owner's Picks that Season, in pick order. The first is their round-1 Pick.

player.description: The Player taken, or null when no Player was recorded for the Pick.

points.description: The Player's Season points: the platform's season total under that Season's scoring, covering the whole NFL regular season (from 2021 that includes week 18). Null when no Player was recorded.

positionalFinish.description: Positional finish: the Player's rank by Season points among every Player at their position that Season, drafted or not (shown as e.g. RB3). Ties share the better rank. Null when no Player was recorded.

valueOverSlot.description: Value over slot: the Pick's order among that Season's Picks at its position (1 = the first QB taken), minus its finish by Season points among the drafted Players at that position (ties share the better finish). Positive outplayed where it went (a Steal). Rank-based: it ranks the Steals list, not the Draft grade. Null when no Player was recorded; such Picks are left out.

pointsOverExpected.description: Points over expected: the Pick's Points above replacement minus what a Pick in that Round usually returns (the mean Points above replacement of every recorded Pick in the Round, across every Season), rounded to whole points. Positive beat the Round, negative fell short. Null when no Player was recorded; such Picks are left out.

headToHead.description: One row per opponent Owner played at least once, former Owners included. Ordered by meetings (descending), then opponent name.

regularSeason.description: The Owner's record against this opponent in regular-season Matchups.

playoffs.description: The Owner's record against this opponent under the Playoff record rule.

meetings.description: Regular-season plus playoff Matchups between the two (consolation and Third-place games excluded). Never 0.

draft.title: Draft history document
draft.description: The Draft section: every Season's first round. Exported as draft.json.

seasons.description: One entry per Season, newest first.

year.description: The Season. Its full board is on the Season page's Draft tab.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises, so the number of first-round Picks.

type.description: How the Draft was run, as in the Season document's draft.type.

firstRound.description: The round-1 Picks in pick order: one per Franchise.

overall.description: Overall pick number, which in round 1 is also the Draft slot.

owner.description: The Owner of the Franchise that made the Pick.

teamName.description: That Franchise's team name that Season.

player.description: The Player taken, or null when no Player was recorded for the Pick.

steals.description: Steals: the 10 Picks with the highest Value over slot across every Season (fewer if there are fewer recorded Picks): who outplayed where they went. Ordered by Value over slot (descending), then Season points (descending), then Season, then overall pick.

hits.description: Hits: the 10 Picks with the highest Points over expected across every Season: the biggest returns on a Pick. Ordered by Points over expected (descending), then Season points (descending), then Season, then overall pick.

busts.description: Busts: the 10 Picks with the lowest Points over expected across every Season. Ordered by Points over expected (ascending), then Season points (ascending: every Pick below replacement floors to the same value, so the fewest points is the worst), then Season, then overall pick.

bestDrafters.description: Every Owner who has drafted, by average Draft grade rank across their Seasons (ascending), then name.

seasons.description: Seasons counted: every Season the Owner drafted in.

averageRank.description: Mean of the Owner's Draft grade ranks, rounded to 2 decimals. Lower is better.

allTimePick.description: A recorded Pick named in the all-time Steals, Hits or Busts.

owner.description: The Owner of the Franchise that made the Pick.

teamName.description: That Franchise's team name that Season.

positionalFinish.description: The Player's Positional finish that Season.

valueOverSlot.description: The Pick's Value over slot (ranks the Steals).

pointsOverExpected.description: The Pick's Points over expected (ranks the Hits and Busts).

matchups.title: Matchups document
matchups.description: The Matchups section: championship cards, leaderboards and the rivalry grid. Exported as matchups.json.

championships.description: One card per Season's championship Matchup, newest first. Each matches that Season's bracket.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks it spans; two for a two-week final, whose scores are combined.

margin.description: Margin: the Champion's score minus the runner-up's, rounded to 2 decimals.

leaderboards.description: Top-10 lists over the Counted Matchups (GLOSSARY). Ties are ordered by Season, then Week, then Owner name (the winner's, or the team's on the score lists).

highestScores.description: Highest single-side scores first. Each side counts on its own, so one Matchup can appear twice.

lowestScores.description: Lowest single-side scores first. Each side counts on its own.

playoffUpsets.description: Playoff upsets by seed gap (largest first), then Margin.

projectionUpsets.description: Projection upsets by projected deficit (largest first). Only Seasons with lineups have projections.

rivalryGrid.description: Every Owner against every other: the head-to-head record (regular season plus playoffs, head-to-head rules) of each pair that has played.

owners.description: Rows and columns of the grid: every Owner, in Owner-index order.

records.description: One entry per ordered pair that has played (both directions), ordered like the grid. Pairs who never met have none.

wins.description: The row Owner's wins against the column Owner (regular season plus championship-bracket games).

losses.description: The row Owner's losses against the column Owner.

rivalry.title: Rivalry document
rivalry.description: Two Owners' head-to-head history (GLOSSARY: Rivalry). Exported as rivalries/<a>-vs-<b>.json, slugs in alphabetical order, for every pair that has played.

sides.description: The two Owners, slugs in alphabetical order, each with their record against the other.

regularSeason.description: The Owner's regular-season record against the other.

playoffs.description: The Owner's record against the other under the Playoff record rule.

biggestWin.description: The Owner's in-record win over the other with the largest Margin (the earliest on a tie), or null if they never won one.

meetings.description: Games in the record (regular season plus championship bracket). Never 0.

games.description: Every game they've played, newest first, the Third-place game and consolation games included.

rivalryGame.description: One played Matchup between the two Owners of a Rivalry. Team and winner indexes follow the Rivalry's sides.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks it spans; two for a two-week round, whose scores are combined.

kind.description: regular season, playoff (championship bracket), the Third-place game, or a consolation game.

inRecord.description: True if the game counts toward the head-to-head record (regular season and championship-bracket games). The Third-place game and consolation games are listed but not counted.

teams.description: Each side's Franchise that Season: [sides[0]'s, sides[1]'s].

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored, as ESPN recorded them (combined over a two-week round).

winner.description: Index of the winning side (0 or 1), or null on a tie.

isTie.description: True if the game ended level.

margin.description: Margin, rounded to 2 decimals (0 on a tie).

leaderboardSide.description: One Franchise's side of a Counted Matchup on a leaderboard.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored in the Matchup, as ESPN recorded them (manual adjustments excluded).

seed.description: The Franchise's playoff seed in a playoff Matchup; null in the regular season.

leaderboardGame.description: A Counted Matchup on the blowouts or closest-games leaderboard.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

winner.description: The winning side; on a tie, the home side.

loser.description: The losing side; on a tie, the away side.

isTie.description: True if the Matchup ended level.

margin.description: Margin: the winner's score minus the loser's, rounded to 2 decimals (0 on a tie).

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

leaderboardUpset.description: A Playoff upset: a championship-bracket Counted Matchup won by the worse seed.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

winner.description: The winning side; on a tie, the home side.

loser.description: The losing side; on a tie, the away side.

isTie.description: True if the Matchup ended level.

margin.description: Margin: the winner's score minus the loser's, rounded to 2 decimals (0 on a tie).

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

seedGap.description: The winner's seed minus the loser's.

leaderboardProjectionUpset.description: A Projection upset: a Counted Matchup won by the side with the lower Projected score.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

winner.description: The winning side; on a tie, the home side.

loser.description: The losing side; on a tie, the away side.

isTie.description: True if the Matchup ended level.

margin.description: Margin: the winner's score minus the loser's, rounded to 2 decimals (0 on a tie).

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

winnerProjected.description: The winner's Projected score (sum of its starters' projections).

projectedDeficit.description: How far behind the winner was projected: loserProjected minus winnerProjected, rounded to 2 decimals.

leaderboardScore.description: One side's score in a Counted Matchup, on the highest- or lowest-score leaderboard.

weeks.description: The single NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

kind.description: regular = regular season; playoff = a championship-bracket Matchup.

team.description: The side whose score this row is about.

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, Standard + TE premium). Scores across formats aren't comparable.

boxScores.title: Box scores document
boxScores.description: Every played Matchup of one Season with both lineups (GLOSSARY: Box score). Exported as box-scores/<year>.json for Seasons with lineups; byes have no Box score.

matchups.description: Every played Matchup, in Matchup-period order.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks it spans. Its page is /matchups/<year>/<first week>/<a>-vs-<b>/.

kind.description: regular season, playoff (championship bracket), the Third-place game, or a consolation game.

winner.description: home or away, or null on a tie.

isTie.description: True if the Matchup ended level.

boxScoreSide.description: One side of a Box score.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: The Matchup score, as ESPN recorded it (combined over a two-week round; manual adjustments excluded). Equals the starters' points.

projected.description: Projected score: the sum of the starters' projections over the Week(s) (missing projections count as 0).

adjustment.description: A manual score adjustment on this Matchup: counts toward points for in the standings, not toward this score. 0 when none.

weeks.description: The side's lineup for each Week of the Matchup period, in order.

emptySlots.description: Starting slots left empty that Week, in lineup order.

boxScoreEntry.description: One Lineup entry in a Box score.

slot.description: Lineup slot that Week: QB, RB, WR, TE, FLEX, D/ST, K (starters) or BE, IR.

nflTeam.description: The Player's NFL team in that game, or null when unknown.

points.description: Fantasy points that Week, or null when the Player didn't play (no actual stat row).

projected.description: ESPN's projection for that Week, or null when there is none.

season.title: Season document
season.description: Everything the Season page shows for one Season. Exported as seasons/<year>.json.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in the Season.

dataTier.description: Data tier: how much detail survives for the Season. full = lineups, player stats, transactions; partial = league-level results, some detail missing.

label.description: Headline format, e.g. "PPR", "Half PPR", "Standard", "PPR + TE premium".

receptionPoints.description: Points per reception for non-TE positions.

tePremium.description: Extra points per reception for a TE, on top of receptionPoints. 0 when there is no TE premium.

keyValues.description: Headline scoring values to display, in display order.

label.description: What is scored, with its unit, e.g. "Passing TD" or "Rushing yard".

points.description: Points awarded for one unit (negative for penalties).

rosterSlots.description: Lineup slots, in display order. Slots with a count of 0 are omitted.

slot.description: Slot label: QB, RB, WR, TE, FLEX, D/ST, K, BE or IR.

count.description: How many of this slot a Franchise has.

draft.description: The Season's Draft: its order and every Pick, in pick order.

type.description: How the Draft was run: snake (the order reverses each round) or offline (run off the platform and entered by hand afterwards, still in snake order).

order.description: The round-1 order: one entry per Franchise, by Draft slot.

slot.description: Draft slot: the Franchise's pick number in round 1, 1..teamCount.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

picks.description: Every Pick, ordered by overall pick number (1..teamCount x rounds).

replacement.description: Replacement level for every position drafted that Season, by position name. A Pick's Points above replacement is its Season points minus its position's points here, floored at 0.

finish.description: Replacement finish: team count x the position's starting slots (each FLEX counts half an RB and half a WR), rounded up; one per team for a position with no starting slot.

points.description: Replacement points: the Season points of the Player at the replacement finish (on a tie that skips it, the nearest finish above; with fewer Players at the position, the last one).

grades.description: Draft grades: one entry per Franchise, ordered by rank, then Owner name. A Draft grade is the sum of the Franchise's Points over expected, ranked within the Season; ties share the better rank.

rank.description: Rank within the Season, 1 = best Draft.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

total.description: The sum of the Franchise's Points over expected.

best.description: The Franchise's Pick with the highest Points over expected (the earliest Pick on a tie).

worst.description: The Franchise's Pick with the lowest Points over expected (the earliest Pick on a tie).

note.description: A caveat shown with the board, e.g. for an offline Draft with Picks not recorded. Null when there is nothing to say.

podium.description: The Podium: Champion, runner-up and Third-place game winner, in that order.

lastPlace.description: Last place: the Franchise with the highest playoffSeed (worst regular-season standing). Not derived from final rank.

teamName.description: The Last place Franchise's team name that Season.

punishment.description: The Season's Punishment. Always null in v1; the site shows "Punishment details coming soon".

standings.description: Final standings, one entry per Franchise, ordered by rank.

rank.description: Final finish, 1 = Champion. Includes playoff and consolation results.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

pointsFor.description: Regular-season points scored, including manual score adjustments (matches ESPN).

pointsAgainst.description: Regular-season points scored against the Franchise.

playoffSeed.description: Regular-season rank 1..teamCount with ESPN tiebreakers applied. The highest seed is Last place.

rounds.description: Playoff rounds in order; the last is the championship, holding exactly one Matchup.

matchupPeriod.description: The Matchup period the round is played in.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks the round spans. Two Weeks for a two-week round, whose scores are combined.

matchups.description: The round's Matchups, including first-round byes.

thirdPlaceGame.description: The Third-place game: the two semifinal losers. Its winner takes 3rd.

matchupPeriod.description: The Matchup period it is played in (the championship's period).

matchup.description: The Matchup itself. Never a bye.

weeklyResults.description: Every Matchup period in the Season, regular season and playoffs, in order.

weeks.description: The NFL Weeks the Matchup period spans.

matchups.description: Every Matchup in the period, consolation Matchups and byes included.

roundPick.description: Pick within the round, from 1. Shown as round.pick, e.g. 3.07.

owner.description: The Owner of the Franchise that made the Pick.

player.description: The Player taken, or null when no Player was recorded for the Pick.

points.description: The Player's Season points: the platform's season total under that Season's scoring, covering the whole NFL regular season (from 2021 that includes week 18). Null when no Player was recorded.

positionalFinish.description: Positional finish: the Player's rank by Season points among every Player at their position that Season, drafted or not (shown as e.g. RB3). Ties share the better rank. Null when no Player was recorded.

valueOverSlot.description: Value over slot: the Pick's order among that Season's Picks at its position (1 = the first QB taken), minus its finish by Season points among the drafted Players at that position (ties share the better finish). Positive outplayed where it went (a Steal). Rank-based: it ranks the Steals list, not the Draft grade. Null when no Player was recorded; such Picks are left out.

pointsOverExpected.description: Points over expected: the Pick's Points above replacement minus what a Pick in that Round usually returns (the mean Points above replacement of every recorded Pick in the Round, across every Season), rounded to whole points. Positive beat the Round, negative fell short. Null when no Player was recorded; such Picks are left out.

gradedPick.description: A recorded Pick with its Points over expected, as named in a Draft grade.

draftPlayer.description: A drafted Player, as of that Season.

position.description: Position: QB, RB, WR, TE, K, D/ST (others are possible but rare).

nflTeam.description: NFL team abbreviation that Season, e.g. KC. One value per Season, so not necessarily the team on draft day. Null for a free agent.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

transactions.title: Transactions document
transactions.description: The Transactions section: every executed trade, scored by the starter points each side's received Players gave their new team. Season and Owner pages filter it at site build time. Exported as transactions.json.

trades.description: Every executed trade (commissioner-vetoed trades are left out), newest Season first, then newest Week, then the first side's Owner name.

pickups.description: Best pickups: the top 10 Pickups of all time by starter points over the Stint. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Week, then Owner name, then Player name.

pickup.description: A Pickup (GLOSSARY): an executed waiver claim or free-agent add, scored for the acquiring Franchise over the Stint.

position.description: That Season's position: QB, RB, WR, TE, K, D/ST ...

nflTeam.description: That Season's NFL team abbreviation; null for a free agent.

teamName.description: The acquiring Franchise's team name that Season.

week.description: The Week the Player was added.

via.description: waiver (a processed waiver claim) or free_agent (added straight from free agency).

points.description: Starter points for the acquiring Franchise during the Stint, playoff Weeks included. Bench Weeks score nothing.

weeksStarted.description: Weeks the Player started for the acquiring Franchise during the Stint.

scoringFormat.description: That Season's Scoring format label, e.g. PPR.

trade.description: One executed trade (GLOSSARY: Trade) and its two sides.

week.description: The effective Week: the first Week the received Players were on their new rosters.

scoringFormat.description: That Season's Scoring format label, e.g. PPR.

margin.description: Margin (GLOSSARY): the winning side's total minus the losing side's. 0 for a tie.

sides.description: Both sides: the winner first; a tie orders them by Owner name.

tradeSide.description: What one Franchise received in a trade, and how it scored for them.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

outcome.description: won, lost or tied: this side's total against the other's.

total.description: The side score: the received Players' starter points over their Stints, playoff Weeks included.

players.description: The Players this side received, most points first, then by name.

tradedPlayer.description: A Player received in a trade, scored for the receiving Franchise over the Stint (GLOSSARY): from the trade's Week until the Player next left that team, to the end of the Season at most.

position.description: That Season's position: QB, RB, WR, TE, K, D/ST ...

nflTeam.description: That Season's NFL team abbreviation; null for a free agent.

points.description: Starter points for the receiving Franchise during the Stint. Bench Weeks score nothing.

weeksStarted.description: Weeks the Player started for the receiving Franchise during the Stint.

recordBook.title: Record Book document
recordBook.description: The Record Book section: cross-Season records. Single-game extremes stay in matchups.json. Exported as record-book.json.

week.description: Week records: top-10 lists over the Counted Matchups. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Week, then Owner name.

mostPointsInLoss.description: Highest scores in a loss. A tied Matchup is neither a win nor a loss.

fewestPointsInWin.description: Lowest scores in a win. A tied Matchup is neither a win nor a loss.

mostBenchPoints.description: Most Bench points in a Week. Only Weeks with lineups.

season.description: Season records: top-10 lists of Franchise-Seasons, regular season only. Points rank per game so 13-game and 14-game Seasons compare fairly.

bestWinPct.description: Top 10 Franchise-Seasons by win %, highest first. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

worstWinPct.description: Bottom 10 Franchise-Seasons by win %, lowest first. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

mostPointsFor.description: Top 10 Franchise-Seasons by Points per game, highest first. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

fewestPointsFor.description: Bottom 10 Franchise-Seasons by Points per game, lowest first. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

mostPointsAgainst.description: Top 10 Franchise-Seasons by points against per game, highest first. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

mostBenchPoints.description: Top 10 Franchise-Seasons by Bench points over regular-season Weeks, highest first. Only Seasons with lineups. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

luckiest.description: Top 10 Franchise-Seasons by Luck index, highest first. Only Seasons with lineups. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

unluckiest.description: Bottom 10 Franchise-Seasons by Luck index, lowest first. Only Seasons with lineups. Ties go to the earlier Season, then Owner name.

allTime.description: One row per Owner, former Owners included, no minimum games. Regular-season totals across every Season. Ordered by wins (descending), then name.

winPct.description: (wins + ties / 2) / games, 0 to 1, to four decimals.

pointsFor.description: Regular-season points scored across every Season.

benchPoints.description: Bench points over regular-season Weeks, summed over the Seasons with lineups; null if none have them.

luck.description: All-time Luck index: the sum of the Owner's Seasons' Luck index (Seasons with lineups); null if none have lineups.

longestWinStreak.description: The Owner's longest winning Streak, in games (0 if they never won).

longestLossStreak.description: The Owner's longest losing Streak, in games (0 if they never lost).

streaks.description: Streaks (GLOSSARY): runs of consecutive regular-season wins or losses across Seasons, top 10 of each.

wins.description: Longest winning Streaks. Equal lengths go to the earlier start Season, then Week, then Owner name.

losses.description: Longest losing Streaks. Equal lengths go to the earlier start Season, then Week, then Owner name.

lastPlace.description: Last place history: every Season's Last place and how often each Owner has finished there.

seasons.description: One row per Season, newest first. Each matches that Season document's lastPlace.

teamName.description: The Last place Franchise's team name that Season.

pointsFor.description: Regular-season points scored, as in that Season's standings.

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, PPR + TE premium).

tally.description: Every Owner with at least one Last place, ordered by count (descending), then name.

count.description: How many Seasons they finished Last place.

streakRow.description: One Streak: an Owner's run of consecutive regular-season wins, or of losses.

active.description: Still running after the latest Season's last regular-season game.

weekRecordRow.description: One Franchise's side of a Counted Matchup in a Record Book Week record.

week.description: The NFL Week it was played in (two-week rounds aren't Counted Matchups).

benchPoints.description: The record holder's Bench points that Week; null if there's no lineup.

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, PPR + TE premium).

seasonRecordRow.description: One Franchise-Season in a Record Book Season record, regular season only. Uses the Season's standings figures.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

winPct.description: (wins + ties / 2) / games, 0 to 1, to four decimals.

pointsPerGame.description: pointsFor / games, to two decimals (GLOSSARY: Points per game).

benchPoints.description: Bench points over regular-season Weeks; null if the Season has no lineups.

expectedWins.description: Expected wins (GLOSSARY): all-play win % x games, to two decimals; null if the Season has no lineups.

luck.description: Luck index (GLOSSARY): wins - Expected wins (unrounded), to one decimal; null if the Season has no lineups.

scoringFormat.description: The Season's Scoring format label (e.g. PPR, PPR + TE premium).

punishment.description: A filled-in Punishment. Not produced in v1.

description.description: What the Owner had to do.

image.description: Site path of the picture, or null if there is none. Served behind the passphrase like everything else.

matchupPeriod.description: A Matchup period number, starting at 1.

weeks.description: NFL Week numbers, ascending, no repeats.

weeklySide.description: One Franchise's side of a Matchup in weekly results.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored over the Matchup period, without manual adjustments (as ESPN shows them). On a bye, the points ESPN recorded for the Franchise that Week, or null if none.

bracketSide.description: One Franchise's side of a playoff bracket Matchup.

teamName.description: The Franchise's team name that Season.

score.description: Points scored over the round, combined across both Weeks of a two-week round. Null only on a bye.

matchupRules.description: Consistency rules shared by every Matchup. A bye has no away side, no winner and is not a tie (its one score is optional). Otherwise both sides have a score; a tie has no winner; anything else names its winner.

home.description: The home side. On a bye, the Franchise on the bye.

away.description: The away side; null on a bye.

winner.description: Which side won: "home", "away", or null for a tie or bye.

isTie.description: True if both sides scored the same.

isBye.description: True if the home Franchise had no opponent.

bracketMatchup.description: One Matchup in the playoff bracket.

home.description: The home side (the higher seed). On a bye, the Franchise on the bye.

away.description: The away side; null on a bye.

winner.description: Which side advanced: "home" or "away". Null on a bye (the home Franchise advances without playing) or a tie.

isTie.description: True if both sides scored the same. ESPN breaks playoff ties, so the exporter should rarely set this.

yearList.description: A set of Season years, oldest first, no repeats.

ownerRef.description: A reference to an Owner: a stable slug plus display name. The same slug always carries the same name.

slug.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier for the Owner. Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Never an ESPN ID (ADR-0002).

teamName.description: A Franchise's team name.

year.description: A Season's year. Recorded history starts in 2018.

teamCount.description: Number of Franchises in a Season.
